dataset.note: 3A.2 freeze. No example add/remove/edit. External val unused for selection.

foldConstruction.algorithm: Seeded shuffle of families (mulberry32, seed 42), then greedy placement largest-first into the fold with fewest families, then fewest rows, then smaller |DEV-NON| imbalance, then fewer copies of that domain. Entire family stays in one fold.

selectionRule: Primary: maximize mean family-held-out balanced accuracy (mean of per-family BA on each fold held-out families).
Consider all configs within 0.005 of the best mean (tie band; avoids non-transitive pairwise comparisons).
Inside that band, prefer lower fold std of family BA.
If still tied, prefer higher mean both-sides-correct rate among two-polarity held-out families.
If still tied, prefer stronger L2, then fewer epochs, then lower learning rate.
Threshold fixed at 0.5. External 92-row val was not used.
